title: Editor で「x」を打った 1 回

fields.clock: the timer clock when it happened: ticks << 8 plus 1/256ths of the current tick, the unit scheduler.charge counts CPU time in
fields.thread: the kernel's current-thread slot (g_current_thread_slot); -1 is none running
fields.program: where the function is: kernel, or the user program whose address space it ran in
fields.fn: the function, as the source names it
fields.ev: enter, exit (a return; unwound: ended by a return further down the stack, as frames a thread switch left do), irq (an interrupt or trap vectored: cause, the trap, syscall and OS_CALL service, and the program it interrupted), iret (the interrupted code resumed), switch (the current thread changed, from the thread in 'from'), request (the driver's control request that let the guest run from here)
fields.instr: instructions retired since the trace started
